verses.original: Καὶ τὸ ἅπαν πλῆθος αὐτῶν ἀναστὰν ἤγαγον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸν Πιλᾶτον
verses.transliteration: Kai to hapan plēthos autōn anastan ēgagon auton epi ton Pilaton
verses.literal: Then the whole council . . . rose [and] led [Jesus] {away} to - Pilate

verses.original: δὲ ἤρξαντο κατηγορεῖν αὐτοῦ λέγοντες εὕραμεν Τοῦτον διαστρέφοντα ἡμῶν τὸ ἔθνος καὶ κωλύοντα φόρους διδόναι Καίσαρι καὶ λέγοντα ἑαυτὸν εἶναι Χριστὸν βασιλέα
verses.transliteration: de ērxanto katēgorein autou legontes heuramen Touton diastrephonta hēmōn to ethnos kai kōlyonta phorous didonai Kaisari kai legonta heauton einai Christon basilea
verses.literal: And they began to accuse Him saying We found this [man] subverting our - nation - forbidding payment of taxes . . . to Caesar and proclaiming Himself to be Christ a King

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος ἠρώτησεν αὐτὸν λέγων εἶ Σὺ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων Σὺ λέγεις δὲ Ὁ ἀποκριθεὶς αὐτῷ ἔφη
verses.transliteration: de Ho Pilatos ērōtēsen auton legōn ei Sy ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn Sy legeis de Ho apokritheis autō ephē
verses.literal: So - Pilate asked Him - Are You the King of the Jews You have said [so] - - [Jesus] replied - -

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Πιλᾶτος εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τοὺς ὄχλους εὑρίσκω Οὐδὲν αἴτιον ἐν τούτῳ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ
verses.transliteration: de Ho Pilatos eipen pros tous archiereis kai tous ochlous heuriskō Ouden aition en toutō tō anthrōpō
verses.literal: Then - Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds I find no basis for a charge against this - man

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἐπίσχυον λέγοντες ὅτι Ἀνασείει τὸν λαὸν ὅλης καθ’ τῆς Ἰουδαίας διδάσκων καὶ ἀρξάμενος ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἕως ὧδε
verses.transliteration: de Hoi epischyon legontes hoti Anaseiei ton laon holēs kath’ tēs Ioudaias didaskōn kai arxamenos apo tēs Galilaias heōs hōde
verses.literal: But - they kept insisting . . . - He stirs up the people all over - Judea [with His] teaching - He began in - Galilee [and has come] all the way here

verses.original: δὲ Πιλᾶτος ἀκούσας ἐπηρώτησεν εἰ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐστιν Γαλιλαῖός
verses.transliteration: de Pilatos akousas epērōtēsen ei ho anthrōpos estin Galilaios
verses.literal: When Pilate heard [this] he asked if the man was a Galilean

verses.original: καὶ ἐπιγνοὺς ὅτι ἐστὶν ἐκ Ἡρῴδου τῆς ἐξουσίας ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν πρὸς Ἡρῴδην αὐτὸν καὶ ὄντα ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν ταύταις ταῖς ἡμέραις
verses.transliteration: kai epignous hoti estin ek Hērōdou tēs exousias anepempsen auton pros Hērōdēn auton kai onta en Hierosolymois en tautais tais hēmerais
verses.literal: And learning that [Jesus] was under Herod’s - jurisdiction he sent Him . . . to Herod [who] himself . . . was in Jerusalem at that - time

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἡρῴδης ἰδὼν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἦν λίαν ἐχάρη γὰρ θέλων ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν ἐξ ἱκανῶν χρόνων διὰ τὸ ἀκούειν περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤλπιζέν ἰδεῖν ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ γινόμενον τι σημεῖον
verses.transliteration: de Ho Hērōdēs idōn ton Iēsoun ēn lian echarē gar thelōn idein auton ex hikanōn chronōn dia to akouein peri autou kai ēlpizen idein hyp’ autou ginomenon ti sēmeion
verses.literal: When - Herod saw - Jesus he was greatly pleased - He had wanted to see Him for a long time because - he had heard about Him and was hoping to see - Him perform a miracle

verses.original: δὲ ἐπηρώτα αὐτὸν ἐν ἱκανοῖς λόγοις δὲ αὐτὸς ἀπεκρίνατο αὐτῷ οὐδὲν
verses.transliteration: de epērōta auton en hikanois logois de autos apekrinato autō ouden
verses.literal: - [Herod] questioned [Jesus] at great [length] but He gave no answer . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς Εἱστήκεισαν εὐτόνως κατηγοροῦντες αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis Heistēkeisan eutonōs katēgorountes autou
verses.literal: Meanwhile the chief priests and - scribes stood there vehemently accusing Him

verses.original: δὲ καὶ Ἡρῴδης σὺν τοῖς αὐτοῦ στρατεύμασιν ἐξουθενήσας αὐτὸν ὁ καὶ ἐμπαίξας περιβαλὼν λαμπρὰν ἐσθῆτα ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν τῷ Πιλάτῳ
verses.transliteration: de kai Hērōdēs syn tois autou strateumasin exouthenēsas auton ho kai empaixas peribalōn lampran esthēta anepempsen auton tō Pilatō
verses.literal: And even Herod and - his soldiers ridiculed . . . - and mocked [Him] Dressing [Him] in a fine robe they sent Him back . . . to Pilate

verses.original: ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ ἡμέρᾳ δὲ τε ὅ Ἡρῴδης καὶ ὁ Πιλᾶτος Ἐγένοντο φίλοι μετ’ ἀλλήλων γὰρ προϋπῆρχον ὄντες ἐν ἔχθρᾳ πρὸς αὑτούς
verses.transliteration: en tē autē hēmera de te ho Hērōdēs kai ho Pilatos Egenonto philoi met’ allēlōn gar proupērchon ontes en echthra pros hautous
verses.literal: vvv vvv That day - - - Herod and - Pilate became friends - - - before this [time] they had been vvv enemies . . . . . .

verses.original: δὲ Πιλᾶτος συνκαλεσάμενος τοὺς ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τὸν λαὸν
verses.transliteration: de Pilatos synkalesamenos tous archiereis kai tous archontas kai ton laon
verses.literal: Then Pilate called together the chief priests - the rulers and the people

verses.original: εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Προσηνέγκατέ μοι τοῦτον τὸν ἄνθρωπον ὡς ἀποστρέφοντα τὸν λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ ἀνακρίνας ἰδοὺ ἐνώπιον ὑμῶν εὗρον ἐν τούτῳ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ οὐθὲν αἴτιον ὧν κατηγορεῖτε κατ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: eipen pros autous Prosēnenkate moi touton ton anthrōpon hōs apostrephonta ton laon kai egō anakrinas idou enōpion hymōn heuron en toutō tō anthrōpō outhen aition hōn katēgoreite kat’ autou
verses.literal: [and] said to them You brought me this - man as [one who] was inciting the people {to rebellion} - I have examined [Him] here in your presence . . . [and] found - vvv vvv [Him] not guilty of your charges against Him

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ Ἡρῴδης γὰρ ἀνέπεμψεν αὐτὸν πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτῷ ἐστὶν πεπραγμένον οὐδὲν ἄξιον θανάτου
verses.transliteration: all’ oude Hērōdēs gar anepempsen auton pros hēmas kai idou autō estin pepragmenon ouden axion thanatou
verses.literal: - Neither [has] Herod for he sent Him back . . . to us - As you can see He has done nothing deserving of death

verses.original: οὖν παιδεύσας αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω
verses.transliteration: oun paideusas auton apolysō
verses.literal: Therefore I will punish Him [and] release [Him]

verses.original: δὲ Ἀνέκραγον παμπληθεὶ λέγοντες Αἶρε τοῦτον δὲ ἀπόλυσον τὸν Βαραββᾶν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: de Anekragon pamplēthei legontes Aire touton de apolyson ton Barabban hēmin
verses.literal: But they all cried out in unison . . . Away with this [man] - Release - Barabbas to us

verses.original: ὅστις ἦν βληθεὶς ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ διὰ τινὰ στάσιν γενομένην ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ φόνον
verses.transliteration: hostis ēn blētheis en tē phylakē dia tina stasin genomenēn en tē polei kai phonon
verses.literal: ([Barabbas] . . . had been imprisoned . . . . . . . . . for an insurrection - in the city and for murder

verses.original: δὲ θέλων ἀπολῦσαι τὸν Ἰησοῦν ὁ Πιλᾶτος προσεφώνησεν αὐτοῖς Πάλιν
verses.transliteration: de thelōn apolysai ton Iēsoun ho Pilatos prosephōnēsen autois Palin
verses.literal: - Wanting to release - Jesus - Pilate addressed them again

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἐπεφώνουν λέγοντες Σταύρου σταύρου αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de hoi epephōnoun legontes Staurou staurou auton
verses.literal: but - they kept shouting . . . Crucify [Him] Crucify Him

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ τρίτον εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς γὰρ Τί κακὸν οὗτος ἐποίησεν εὗρον ἐν αὐτῷ οὐδὲν αἴτιον θανάτου οὖν παιδεύσας αὐτὸν ἀπολύσω
verses.transliteration: de Ho triton eipen pros autous gar Ti kakon houtos epoiēsen heuron en autō ouden aition thanatou oun paideusas auton apolysō
verses.literal: - - A third [time] he said to them - What evil {has} this [man] done I have found in Him no offense worthy of death So after I punish Him I will release [Him]

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ ἐπέκειντο αἰτούμενοι φωναῖς μεγάλαις αὐτὸν σταυρωθῆναι καὶ αὐτῶν αἱ φωναὶ κατίσχυον
verses.transliteration: de Hoi epekeinto aitoumenoi phōnais megalais auton staurōthēnai kai autōn hai phōnai katischyon
verses.literal: But - they were insistent demanding with loud voices . . . for [Jesus] to be crucified And their - clamor prevailed

verses.original: καὶ Πιλᾶτος ἐπέκρινεν αὐτῶν τὸ αἴτημα γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: kai Pilatos epekrinen autōn to aitēma genesthai
verses.literal: So Pilate sentenced [that] their - demand be met

verses.original: δὲ ὃν ᾐτοῦντο ἀπέλυσεν τὸν βεβλημένον εἰς φυλακὴν διὰ στάσιν καὶ φόνον δὲ παρέδωκεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν τῷ αὐτῶν θελήματι
verses.transliteration: de hon ētounto apelysen ton beblēmenon eis phylakēn dia stasin kai phonon de paredōken ton Iēsoun tō autōn thelēmati
verses.literal: As - they had requested he released the [one] imprisoned . . . . . . for insurrection and murder and he handed - Jesus over to their will

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἀπήγαγον αὐτόν ἐπιλαβόμενοι Σίμωνά τινα Κυρηναῖον ἐρχόμενον ἀπ’ ἀγροῦ ἐπέθηκαν τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτῷ φέρειν ὄπισθεν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs apēgagon auton epilabomenoi Simōna tina Kyrēnaion erchomenon ap’ agrou epethēkan ton stauron autō pherein opisthen tou Iēsou
verses.literal: - As [the soldiers] led Him away . . . they seized Simon - of Cyrene on his way in from the country [and] they put the cross on him to carry behind - Jesus

verses.original: δὲ πολὺ πλῆθος τοῦ λαοῦ Ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ καὶ γυναικῶν αἳ ἐκόπτοντο καὶ ἐθρήνουν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de poly plēthos tou laou Ēkolouthei autō kai gynaikōn hai ekoptonto kai ethrēnoun auton
verses.literal: - A great number - of people followed Him including women who kept mourning and wailing for Him

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς στραφεὶς πρὸς αὐτὰς εἶπεν Θυγατέρες Ἰερουσαλήμ μὴ κλαίετε ἐπ’ ἐμέ πλὴν κλαίετε ἐφ’ ἑαυτὰς καὶ ἐπὶ ὑμῶν τὰ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous strapheis pros autas eipen Thygateres Ierousalēm mē klaiete ep’ eme plēn klaiete eph’ heautas kai epi hymōn ta tekna
verses.literal: But - Jesus turned to them [and] said Daughters of Jerusalem {do} not weep for Me but weep for yourselves and for your - children

verses.original: ὅτι ἰδοὺ ἡμέραι ἔρχονται ἐν αἷς ἐροῦσιν Μακάριαι αἱ στεῖραι καὶ αἱ κοιλίαι αἳ οὐκ ἐγέννησαν καὶ μαστοὶ οἳ οὐκ ἔθρεψαν
verses.transliteration: hoti idou hēmerai erchontai en hais erousin Makariai hai steirai kai hai koiliai hai ouk egennēsan kai mastoi hoi ouk ethrepsan
verses.literal: - Look [the] days are coming vvv when [people] will say Blessed [are] the barren [women] - the wombs that never bore and breasts that never nursed

verses.original: τότε Ἄρξονται λέγειν τοῖς ὄρεσιν Πέσετε ἐφ’ ἡμᾶς Καὶ τοῖς βουνοῖς Καλύψατε ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: tote Arxontai legein tois oresin Pesete eph’ hēmas Kai tois bounois Kalypsate hēmas
verses.literal: At that time vvv they will say to the mountains Fall on us and to the hills Cover us

verses.original: Ὅτι εἰ ποιοῦσιν ταῦτα ἐν τῷ ξύλῳ ὑγρῷ τί γένηται ἐν τῷ ξηρῷ
verses.transliteration: Hoti ei poiousin tauta en tō xylō hygrō ti genētai en tō xērō
verses.literal: For if [men] do these things [while] the tree [is] green what will happen [when] [it is] dry

verses.original: δὲ δύο ἕτεροι κακοῦργοι καὶ Ἤγοντο ἀναιρεθῆναι σὺν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de dyo heteroi kakourgoi kai Ēgonto anairethēnai syn autō
verses.literal: - Two others [who were] criminals vvv were also led away to be executed with [Jesus]

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Κρανίον ἐσταύρωσαν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ καὶ τοὺς κακούργους ὃν μὲν ἐκ δεξιῶν δὲ ὃν ἐξ ἀριστερῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai hote ēlthon epi ton topon ton kaloumenon Kranion estaurōsan auton ekei kai tous kakourgous hon men ek dexiōn de hon ex aristerōn
verses.literal: - When they came to the place - called The Skull they crucified Him there along with the criminals one - on [His] right and [the other] on [His] left

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἔλεγεν Πάτερ ἄφες αὐτοῖς γὰρ οὐ οἴδασιν τί ποιοῦσιν δὲ διαμεριζόμενοι αὐτοῦ τὰ ἱμάτια ἔβαλον κλήρους
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous elegen Pater aphes autois gar ou oidasin ti poiousin de diamerizomenoi autou ta himatia ebalon klērous
verses.literal: Then - Jesus said Father forgive them for vvv they do not know what they are doing And they divided up His - garments by casting lots

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ λαὸς εἱστήκει θεωρῶν δὲ οἱ ἄρχοντες καὶ ἐξεμυκτήριζον λέγοντες ἔσωσεν Ἄλλους σωσάτω ἑαυτόν εἰ οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἐκλεκτός
verses.transliteration: Kai ho laos heistēkei theōrōn de hoi archontes kai exemyktērizon legontes esōsen Allous sōsatō heauton ei houtos estin ho Christos tou Theou ho eklektos
verses.literal: - The people stood watching and the rulers - sneered at [Him] saying He saved others let Him save Himself if [He] is the Christ - of God the Chosen [One]

verses.original: δὲ οἱ στρατιῶται καὶ Ἐνέπαιξαν αὐτῷ προσερχόμενοι προσφέροντες αὐτῷ ὄξος
verses.transliteration: de hoi stratiōtai kai Enepaixan autō proserchomenoi prospherontes autō oxos
verses.literal: - The soldiers also mocked Him [and] came up to offer Him sour wine

verses.original: Εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ λέγοντες σῶσον σεαυτόν
verses.transliteration: Ei sy ei ho Basileus tōn Ioudaiōn kai legontes sōson seauton
verses.literal: If You are the King of the Jews - they said save Yourself

verses.original: δὲ ἐπ’ αὐτῷ Ἦν καὶ ἐπιγραφὴ ΟΥΤΟΣ Ο ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥΣ ΤΩΝ ΙΟΥΔΑΙΩΝ
verses.transliteration: de ep’ autō Ēn kai epigraphē HOUTOS HO BASILEUS TŌN IOUDAIŌN
verses.literal: - Above Him was [posted] - an inscription THIS [IS] THE KING OF THE JEWS

verses.original: δὲ Εἷς τῶν κακούργων κρεμασθέντων ἐβλασφήμει αὐτόν εἶ σὺ Οὐχὶ ὁ Χριστός λέγων σῶσον σεαυτὸν καὶ ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de Heis tōn kakourgōn kremasthentōn eblasphēmei auton ei sy Ouchi ho Christos legōn sōson seauton kai hēmas
verses.literal: - One of the criminals who hung [there] heaped abuse on Him vvv Are You not the Christ he said Save Yourself and us

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἕτερος Ἀποκριθεὶς ἐπιτιμῶν αὐτῷ ἔφη σὺ Οὐδὲ φοβῇ τὸν Θεόν ὅτι εἶ ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ κρίματι
verses.transliteration: de ho heteros Apokritheis epitimōn autō ephē sy Oude phobē ton Theon hoti ei en tō autō krimati
verses.literal: But the other [one] vvv rebuked him saying {Do} you not even fear - God since you are under the same judgment

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς μὲν δικαίως γὰρ ἀπολαμβάνομεν ὧν ἐπράξαμεν ἄξια δὲ οὗτος ἔπραξεν οὐδὲν ἄτοπον
verses.transliteration: kai hēmeis men dikaiōs gar apolambanomen hōn epraxamen axia de houtos epraxen ouden atopon
verses.literal: - We [ are punished ] justly for we are receiving what our actions deserve But [this] man has done nothing wrong

verses.original: καὶ ἔλεγεν Ἰησοῦ μνήσθητί μου ὅταν ἔλθῃς εἰς σου τὴν βασιλείαν
verses.transliteration: kai elegen Iēsou mnēsthēti mou hotan elthēs eis sou tēn basileian
verses.literal: Then he said Jesus remember me when You come into Your - kingdom

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀμήν λέγω σοι σήμερον ἔσῃ μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ Παραδείσῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autō Amēn legō soi sēmeron esē met’ emou en tō Paradeisō
verses.literal: And [Jesus] said to him Truly I tell you today you will be with Me in - Paradise

verses.original: Καὶ ἤδη ἦν ὡσεὶ ἕκτη ὥρα καὶ σκότος ἐγένετο ἐφ’ ὅλην τὴν γῆν ἕως ἐνάτης ὥρας
verses.transliteration: Kai ēdē ēn hōsei hektē hōra kai skotos egeneto eph’ holēn tēn gēn heōs enatēs hōras
verses.literal: - vvv It was now about [the] sixth hour and darkness came over all the land until [the] ninth hour

verses.original: τοῦ ἡλίου ἐκλιπόντος δὲ τὸ καταπέτασμα τοῦ ναοῦ ἐσχίσθη μέσον
verses.transliteration: tou hēliou eklipontos de to katapetasma tou naou eschisthē meson
verses.literal: The sun was darkened and the veil of the temple was torn down [the] middle

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς φωνήσας μεγάλῃ φωνῇ εἶπεν Πάτερ εἰς σου χεῖράς παρατίθεμαι μου τὸ πνεῦμά δὲ εἰπὼν τοῦτο ἐξέπνευσεν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous phōnēsas megalē phōnē eipen Pater eis sou cheiras paratithemai mou to pneuma de eipōn touto exepneusen
verses.literal: Then - Jesus called out vvv in a loud voice . . . Father into Your hands I commit My - Spirit And when He had said this He breathed His last

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἑκατοντάρχης Ἰδὼν τὸ γενόμενον ἐδόξαζεν τὸν Θεὸν λέγων Ὄντως οὗτος ἦν δίκαιος ὁ ἄνθρωπος
verses.transliteration: de ho hekatontarchēs Idōn to genomenon edoxazen ton Theon legōn Ontōs houtos ēn dikaios ho anthrōpos
verses.literal: When the centurion saw what had happened he gave glory - to God saying Surely this was [a] righteous - man

verses.original: καὶ πάντες οἱ ὄχλοι συμπαραγενόμενοι ἐπὶ ταύτην τὴν θεωρίαν θεωρήσαντες τὰ γενόμενα ὑπέστρεφον τύπτοντες τὰ στήθη
verses.transliteration: kai pantes hoi ochloi symparagenomenoi epi tautēn tēn theōrian theōrēsantes ta genomena hypestrephon typtontes ta stēthē
verses.literal: And [when] all the people who had gathered for this - spectacle saw what had happened they returned [home] beating [their] breasts

verses.original: δὲ πάντες ἀπὸ οἱ γνωστοὶ αὐτῷ καὶ γυναῖκες αἱ συνακολουθοῦσαι αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἱστήκεισαν μακρόθεν ὁρῶσαι ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: de pantes apo hoi gnōstoi autō kai gynaikes hai synakolouthousai autō apo tēs Galilaias heistēkeisan makrothen horōsai tauta
verses.literal: But all . . . those who knew [Jesus] including [the] women who had followed Him from - Galilee stood at a distance watching these things

verses.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ὑπάρχων καὶ βουλευτὴς ὀνόματι Ἰωσὴφ ἀγαθὸς καὶ δίκαιος ἀνὴρ
verses.transliteration: Kai idou anēr hyparchōn kai bouleutēs onomati Iōsēph agathos kai dikaios anēr
verses.literal: Now [there was] vvv vvv vvv a Council member named Joseph a good and righteous man

verses.original: οὗτος ἦν οὐκ συνκατατεθειμένος τῇ αὐτῶν βουλῇ καὶ τῇ πράξει ἀπὸ πόλεως τῶν Ἰουδαίων Ἁριμαθαίας ὃς προσεδέχετο τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos ēn ouk synkatatetheimenos tē autōn boulē kai tē praxei apo poleōs tōn Ioudaiōn Harimathaias hos prosedecheto tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: [who] vvv vvv had not consented to their decision [or] - action [He was] from [the] Judean town . . . . . . [of] Arimathea [and] was waiting for the kingdom - of God

verses.original: οὗτος προσελθὼν τῷ Πιλάτῳ ᾐτήσατο τὸ σῶμα τοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos proselthōn tō Pilatō ētēsato to sōma tou Iēsou
verses.literal: He went - to Pilate to ask [for] the body - of Jesus

verses.original: καὶ καθελὼν ἐνετύλιξεν αὐτὸ σινδόνι καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐν μνήματι λαξευτῷ οὗ οὐδεὶς οὐκ οὔπω ἦν κείμενος
verses.transliteration: kai kathelōn enetylixen auto sindoni kai ethēken auton en mnēmati laxeutō hou oudeis ouk oupō ēn keimenos
verses.literal: Then he took it down wrapped it in a linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut into the rock where no one . . . vvv had yet been laid

verses.original: καὶ ἦν Παρασκευῆς ἡμέρα καὶ σάββατον ἐπέφωσκεν
verses.transliteration: kai ēn Paraskeuēs hēmera kai sabbaton epephōsken
verses.literal: - It was Preparation Day and [the] Sabbath was beginning

verses.original: δὲ αἱ γυναῖκες αἵτινες ἦσαν συνεληλυθυῖαι αὐτῷ ἐκ τῆς Γαλιλαίας Κατακολουθήσασαι ἐθεάσαντο τὸ μνημεῖον καὶ ὡς αὐτοῦ τὸ σῶμα ἐτέθη
verses.transliteration: de hai gynaikes haitines ēsan synelēlythuiai autō ek tēs Galilaias Katakolouthēsasai etheasanto to mnēmeion kai hōs autou to sōma etethē
verses.literal: - The women who vvv had come with [Jesus] from - Galilee followed [and] they saw the tomb and how His - body was placed

verses.original: δὲ ὑποστρέψασαι ἡτοίμασαν ἀρώματα καὶ μύρα Καὶ ἡσύχασαν μὲν τὸ σάββατον κατὰ τὴν ἐντολήν
verses.transliteration: de hypostrepsasai hētoimasan arōmata kai myra Kai hēsychasan men to sabbaton kata tēn entolēn
verses.literal: Then they returned to prepare spices and perfumes And they rested - on the Sabbath according to the commandment
